title: Field-Visit Recovery for Door-Hanger Final Notices in the Electric Service Agreement Reconnection Charge
content:
This worked-example sheet covers the field-visit recovery in the reconnection charge of an Electric Service Agreement.

**Rule.** A field-visit recovery is added to the restoration charge: 0.6 times the schedule's field reconnection charge for standard hours when three or more final disconnection notices were delivered by door hanger at the premise in the 12 calendar months before the order, 0.3 times that charge when exactly two were, and nothing when one or none was; final notices delivered by phone call are not field visits. The restoration charge is the charge for restoring service on which the reconnection charge rests; the reconnection charge is figured on the sum of the restoration charge and the field-visit recovery, and the recovery is not rounded on its own — only the final reconnection charge is rounded to the cent.

Every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date.

| Door-hanger final notices at the premise in the 12 calendar months before the order | Field-visit recovery |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.6 times the schedule's field reconnection charge for standard hours |
| exactly 2 | 0.3 times that charge |
| 1 or none | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical figures)

Assume a hypothetical schedule whose field reconnection charge for standard hours is 85.00 USD and a restoration charge of 85.00 USD.

| Final notices in the 12 months | Counted door-hanger visits | Recovery | Restoration charge plus recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 door hangers, 1 phone call | 2 | 25.50 | 110.50 |
| 3 door hangers | 3 | 51.00 | 136.00 |
| 1 door hanger, 3 phone calls | 1 | nothing | 85.00 |

With a hypothetical restoration charge of 10.00 USD on the same schedule and 3 door-hanger notices, the recovery is still 0.6 times the 85.00 USD field charge, that is 51.00, and the sum is 61.00.
